short.name: code_fibonacci
short.text: Write a Python function fibonacci(n) that returns the first n Fibonacci numbers. Reject negative input with ValueError. Include type hints, a short docstring, and five unit tests. Return only code.

short.name: code_json
short.text: Write a Python function merge_records(lines) that reads JSON objects from an iterable of strings. Each object has an integer id and a string value. Keep the last value for each id and return objects sorted by id. Reject malformed records with a useful ValueError. Include tests. Return only code.

short.name: chat_planning
short.text: I have two hours on Saturday to clean a small apartment and prepare lunch for three people. I have rice, lentils, carrots, and onions. Give me a practical schedule and a simple recipe. Explain which tasks I can do at the same time.

short.name: chat_explain
short.text: Explain why the sky looks blue during the day and red near sunset. Assume I know basic science but not optics. Use one useful analogy, then explain where that analogy fails.

short.name: chat_spanish
short.text: Explica en español cómo organizar una biblioteca pequeña de barrio. Incluye un sistema sencillo de préstamos, una forma de clasificar los libros y un plan para recibir donaciones. Usa ejemplos concretos.

short.name: prose_story
short.text: Write the opening of a quiet story about a clock repairer who finds a letter inside an old pocket watch. Use concrete sensory details. Do not use magic, a dream, or a surprise inheritance. Keep the point of view in the third person.

short.name: prose_explain
short.text: Write a clear guide to keeping a field notebook during a month of bird observations. Describe useful entries, weather records, uncertain identifications, and how to review the notes. Use complete paragraphs rather than a list.

long.prefix: Read the records below. Each record describes a small test service. The project code is CEDAR-427.
long.record: Service cedar uses port 8123. Its owner is Mira. Backups run every Tuesday. Requests use a thirty-second timeout. Errors go to the local log.
long.suffix: State the project code, service port, owner, backup day, and timeout. Then explain how you would check the service after a restart.
